transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metrorail, Metrobus and Tri-Rail stops are at the Miami Intermodal Center (Miami International Airport station), reached from the airport by the free MIA Mover train from the station on Level 3 between the Dolphin and Flamingo garages. You need an EASY Card to ride; the machines are at the Miami Intermodal Center. A Metrorail ride costs $2.25 one way. The Miami Beach Bus, $2.25, runs every 30 minutes from 6:00 to 23:40 daily between the airport Metrorail station and Miami Beach (from 41st Street to South Pointe Drive).

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxis are on the arrivals level (ground level), at the exits from the baggage claim areas. Metered: $2.95 for the first 1/6 mile, $0.85 for each additional 1/6 mile up to one mile, then $0.55 for each 1/6 mile; waiting $0.40 per minute. Airport fee $2.00, minimum fare from MIA $15. SUVs and minivans carry a 30% surcharge on the meter. Rideshare vehicles pick up on Level 1 (arrivals) and Level 2 (departures).

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: In North Terminal D after security: American Airlines Flagship Lounge opposite gate D-30 (daily 5:00–23:00), Admirals Club above gate D15 on Level 3 (5:00–23:00) and opposite gate D-30 (6:00–20:30). By gate D-12 of the North Terminal is the American Express Centurion Lounge (5:00–22:00). Access to American lounges is based on status and a business- or first-class ticket on American or a oneworld airline; single-entry passes are available for purchase if space is available.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Communitel Baggage Storage left luggage is on Level 2 of Central Terminal E, daily from 5:00 to 21:00, charged per day. Notary services and luggage accessories are also available there.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.hint: Hotel in Terminal E, Wait n' rest
sleep.text: Miami International Airport Hotel on Level 2 of Central Terminal E: 260 soundproofed rooms and the Viena restaurant. Wait n' rest sleep rooms are open round the clock: rooms for 1–4 guests with a shower, towels and snacks.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The interactive Plane Fun kids' zone is in Concourse E by gate E5; it can also be reached from Concourse D. MIAmamas nursing rooms are in every concourse after security.

parking.title: Parking
parking.hint: $2 per 20 min, up to $25 per 24 h
parking.text: Dolphin and Flamingo garages: $2.00 for every 20 minutes; after 4 hours a maximum of $25.00 per 24 hours applies. A space can be paid for in advance, up to a year ahead: entry and exit by the QR code from the email; the booking fee is non-refundable, and a booking can be changed or cancelled no later than 24 hours before. Payment by cash, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and Samsung Pay.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Internet on the airport network is free, with ads. Uninterrupted access: standard $4.95, premium $7.95.
